evidence.title: St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index
evidence.summary: The snapshotted target change was 0.081 index points; it resolved to 'above recent range'.

evidence.title: What Are Financial Market Stress Indexes Showing?
evidence.domain: st. louis fed on the economy
evidence.summary: This article from the St. Louis Fed explains how their Financial Stress Index (STLFSI) is constructed, including the recent change from LIBOR to SOFR, and discusses how it relates to other stress indexes and economic factors like FOMC rate hikes. It highlights that rising interest rates and market volatility can increase financial stress.

evidence.title: Fed done hiking; slim majority of economists say no rate cut through March: Reuters poll | Reuters
evidence.summary: This Reuters poll indicates that a majority of economists expected the Fed to keep interest rates steady in September 2023, but also notes that the Fed Chair kept options open for further hikes. The context of potential further rate hikes or sustained high rates can contribute to financial stress.

evidence.title: Bond market sees no end to tumult as Federal Reserve casts a hawkish shadow | World News - Business Standard
evidence.summary: This article suggests ongoing tumult in the bond market due to the Federal Reserve's hawkish stance. Increased volatility and uncertainty in bond markets, driven by Fed policy, are direct contributors to financial stress.

evidence.title: A Wild Month for Treasuries Is Slow Going for Crypto: Crypto Long & Short
evidence.summary: The article mentions a 'wild month for Treasuries,' indicating significant volatility in the government bond market. Volatility in key financial markets like Treasuries is a component of financial stress indexes.

evidence.title: [한국] 금융스트레스지수 52.2, 전주대비 2.1p 상승-금융불안지수, FSI | KB의 생각
evidence.summary: This report on the Korean Financial Stress Index (FSI) for the second week of August 2023 notes an increase in stress due to stock market declines and increased exchange rate volatility (USD/KRW). It also mentions rising US Treasury yields and falling US stock markets due to interest rate increases, which are global factors influencing financial stress.

evidence.title: Chinese Economic Weakness Elevating Investor Concerns
evidence.summary: Concerns about Chinese economic weakness can lead to global investor uncertainty and risk aversion, which can elevate financial stress in interconnected markets, including the US.

evidence.title: Latest CPI Report Offers Further Evidence Of Easing Inflation For Fed
evidence.summary: Evidence of easing inflation could potentially reduce the pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates further, which might alleviate some financial stress. However, the overall context of the period still points to hawkish sentiment.
